title: Operations Guide — Startup/Shutdown, Common Issues & Fixes, Settings Glossary

starting_everything.recommended: Double-click 'Start LionServices.bat' (or its desktop shortcut) in c:\LionByteGG\LionByteGG\ — single-instance guarded (checks if port 5000 is already LISTENING and refuses to double-launch), launches all 6 services minimized in order, then opens Master Terminal (PyQt6 GUI) for ongoing monitoring.
starting_everything.master_terminal_gui: LionByteGG\master_terminal.py (PyQt6) — start/stop/monitor all 6 services from one window, live CPU/RAM/disk + aggregated logs.

restarting_after_a_code_change.rule: Nova (Flask) runs in PRODUCTION mode with NO auto-reload — you MUST restart the server after editing app.py or ANY template file. Discord bots similarly need a process restart to pick up cog/util changes (or use their /reload, /restart_service, or dashboard restart-queue features).
restarting_after_a_code_change.browser_cache: Templates + static JS/CSS can be cached by the browser — hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5) or cache-bust with a ?t=timestamp query param after a Nova UI change.
restarting_after_a_code_change.static_js_exception: Static JS files (e.g. web/static/js/main.js diagnostics console) do NOT need a server restart, only a hard browser refresh.

known_gotchas_and_fixes.symptom: Users can't log in / login bounces back to the login page intermittently
known_gotchas_and_fixes.cause: Two run.py processes fighting over port 5000 (duplicate server)
known_gotchas_and_fixes.fix: run.py's _ensure_single_instance(port) auto-kills other run.py instances on every launch. Verify only one is running: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='python.exe'" | ? {$_.CommandLine -like '*run.py*'} — should return exactly 1.

known_gotchas_and_fixes.symptom: A user with custom permissions gets bounced to /login?error=no_dashboard_access, or the bot-switcher dropdown lands them on the wrong section
known_gotchas_and_fixes.cause: smart_landing() requires the user's group to have that section's specific 'main dashboard' page permission (page.dashboard for LionByte, page.boilercraft, page.shift_dashboard, page.music_dashboard), not just the section.* + individual page perms
known_gotchas_and_fixes.fix: Grant the missing page.dashboard-equivalent permission to the group in /admin

known_gotchas_and_fixes.symptom: Editing a preset group's permissions in /admin keeps reverting after a server restart
known_gotchas_and_fixes.cause: (HISTORICAL BUG, fixed) init_db() used to hard-reset preset group permissions on every startup via _enforce_preset_permissions()
known_gotchas_and_fixes.fix: Replaced with _seed_preset_permissions() — non-destructive, only seeds a group with ZERO permissions or that's entirely missing; existing custom permissions are left alone

known_gotchas_and_fixes.symptom: Saving a new nested config field (e.g. announcement.pulse) from the Nova UI shows/animates correctly in the live preview but silently doesn't persist after 'Save Settings'
known_gotchas_and_fixes.cause: POST /api/arena/config rebuilds nested config sub-objects from a HARDCODED field whitelist before saving
known_gotchas_and_fixes.fix: When adding a new nested config field, update BOTH the read-side normalizer (e.g. _arena_announcement()) AND the POST handler's inline whitelist dict

known_gotchas_and_fixes.symptom: A multi-team coach or captain isn't getting Discord roles for every team they're on
known_gotchas_and_fixes.cause: /api/rosters/sync-roles/preview and /execute historically only read player['team_id'] (first team only), not the full team_ids array
known_gotchas_and_fixes.fix: Already fixed to loop team_ids; if regression reappears, check that the sync-roles code loops the full array, not just the legacy singular field

known_gotchas_and_fixes.symptom: PC screen locks won't engage even with the toggle flipped on in the UI
known_gotchas_and_fixes.cause: pc_lock_enabled ended up False in data/arena_kiosk_config.json (e.g. a stale save)
known_gotchas_and_fixes.fix: Check arena_kiosk_config.json directly, or re-flip the toggle in Nova -> Arena -> Controls -> PC Screen Locks

known_gotchas_and_fixes.symptom: GGLeap API calls start returning 429 / '0 machines' across the whole arena system
known_gotchas_and_fixes.cause: Daily GGLeap call quota (10,000/day) exhausted — usually from redundant polling loops
known_gotchas_and_fixes.fix: Check /api/arena/ggleap-usage for today's count; if near the cap, temporarily set config key ggleap_paused=true to stop all calls; verify no new independent polling loop was added outside the shared _ggleap_get_machines() cache

known_gotchas_and_fixes.symptom: New sign-in guard settings block legitimate repeat kiosk check-ins
known_gotchas_and_fixes.cause: cooldown_minutes / max_per_day set too aggressively (an earlier default of 15/8 caused this)
known_gotchas_and_fixes.fix: Safe defaults are cooldown_minutes=0, max_per_day=0, max_active_pc=1 — only increase these deliberately and test with a real repeat check-in afterward

known_gotchas_and_fixes.symptom: Large PowerShell-based file edits (e.g. Get-Content | Set-Content) on app.py corrupt special characters
known_gotchas_and_fixes.cause: Windows PowerShell's default Get-Content/Set-Content encoding is NOT UTF-8-safe; multi-byte UTF-8 characters (em-dash —, en-dash –, ellipsis …, middle-dot ·, × sign) can be silently collapsed into invalid single CP1252 bytes
known_gotchas_and_fixes.fix: Never pipe a large source file through Get-Content|Set-Content without explicit -Encoding UTF8, or better, do binary-safe edits in Python (open in 'rb'/'wb' mode). Always verify with `python -c "import app"` after large PowerShell-based edits to catch UnicodeDecodeError immediately.

known_gotchas_and_fixes.symptom: grep_search / other tools report a much higher total line count for app.py than PowerShell's Get-Content | Measure-Object -Line
known_gotchas_and_fixes.cause: Unresolved tooling discrepancy observed 2026-09-04 — Python's readlines() and ripgrep-based search agree with each other (~12,800 lines) while PowerShell Get-Content under-counts (~11,700) even with -Encoding UTF8 specified
known_gotchas_and_fixes.guidance: Trust Python/grep-reported line numbers over PowerShell's Measure-Object -Line count when locating code in app.py; this does not indicate file corruption (verified via successful `python -c "import app"` and a live server test).

arena_kiosk_config.json (data dir).welcome_message: Big welcome text on the kiosk attract screen
arena_kiosk_config.json (data dir).announcement: {enabled,text,color,scroll} — scrolling/static banner on kiosks + Nova preview
arena_kiosk_config.json (data dir).pc_lock_enabled: Master switch for the PC screen-lock automation loop
arena_kiosk_config.json (data dir).pc_hold_minutes: How long a kiosk reservation holds a PC before it's released/re-locked
arena_kiosk_config.json (data dir).ggleap_paused: Emergency kill-switch — stops ALL GGLeap API calls when true
arena_kiosk_config.json (data dir).live_cleared_at: Timestamp used to compute the Live Feed cutoff after a manual 'Clear Live Feed'

settings_glossary.team_role_settings.json: Discord role ID mapping for varsity/JV/captain/coach role sync (see chapter 06)
settings_glossary.settings.json (LionShiftGG): dm_shift_reminders, dm_late_alerts, reminder_minutes_before, late_alert_minutes, dm_new_schedule, allow_shift_trading, webclock/opening/closing form URLs
settings_glossary.bot_config.json (BoilerCraftGG): Ticket panel channel, category name/prefix, staff role, FAQ channel, support_categories
settings_glossary.flagged_words.json (LionByteGG bot + Mod: 3-tier list: bannable (auto-ban), kickable (auto-kick), warning (DM only) — synced to Discord's native AutoMod via utils/automod_sync.py

permission_key_naming_convention.section.NAME: Controls whether a top-level nav section (e.g. Arena Staff) shows in the sidebar at all
permission_key_naming_convention.page.NAME: Controls whether a specific page's nav link renders and whether the route itself is reachable
permission_key_naming_convention.NAME.action: A specific in-page action permission (e.g. arena.manage, moderation.warn, equipment.checkout)
permission_key_naming_convention.admin.panel: Full bypass — grants access to everything, used for the true admin role

shared_data_directory_map.lionbeats_integration: NOT file-based — Nova talks to LionBeatsGG over its own REST API on localhost:3847 instead of a shared data directory

encryption_and_pii.roster_pii: data/.roster_encrypt_key (Fernet) encrypts rosters.json PII fields (email, phone, PUID, major, GPA, etc.)
encryption_and_pii.arena_pii: Uses the SAME Fernet key to encrypt sign-in names/emails, watchlist entries, student notes, and incident report descriptions in arena.db
encryption_and_pii.principle: As of the Aug 2026 PII hardening pass, no plaintext personal data (names/emails) should exist in any plain JSON file in this project — it all lives encrypted in SQLite. If you ever find a JSON file with plaintext PII, that's a regression.
